doubts.title: Frequently Asked Questions
doubts.description: Here are some of the most frequently asked questions about the app and its use.
doubts.not_found_answer: Didn't find your answer? Write to us at
doubts.question_1: How can I search for a verse?
doubts.answer_1:
On the main screen, go to the Bible option and in the top icons where the magnifying glass is...
 You will find options that allow you to navigate through versions, books, chapters and verses, plus access to the teachings and characters section...
doubts.question_2: Can I read the Bible offline?
doubts.answer_2: No, you need to be connected to the internet to access the Bible functionalities
doubts.question_3: How can I change the app theme?
doubts.answer_3:
You can only change the color theme in the Bible section. 
 Go to the Bible, use the personalization icon and select the theme you prefer: light, dark or customized. 
 Additionally, you can change the font type, adjust the font size, these
 data remains saved within the application store
doubts.question_4: Where can I send suggestions or report errors?
doubts.answer_4: Through the email you find in settings "about the app", you can send us your suggestions or report any issues.
